commits.subject: net: TCrtSocket.Close won't reuse a socket handle closed by Abort on Windows
commits.body:
On Windows, TCrtSocket.Abort calls closesocket() to release a blocking recv()
in another thread (shutdown() does not), but fSock kept its value. Close then
let the TLS layer send its close_notify over this stale handle - e.g. SChannel
logging "ESChannel shutdown: Fatal Error 10038 WSAENOTSOCK" when THttpServer
is stopped with idle keep-alive connections - and called closesocket() a
second time. Since Windows reuses SOCKET values at once, both could hit an
unrelated connection of the process.

- new fAbortClosed flag, set by Abort before closesocket()
- Close then skips the second closesocket() and calls the new
  INetTls.SocketClosed method, so SChannel/OpenSSL won't send close_notify
- TNetworkProtocols.CrtSocketAbort regression test with a fake INetTls

See https://synopse.info/forum/viewtopic.php?id=7622
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: ui: pdf - an empty EMF clip region clips everything, with a valid path
commits.body:
GDI records SelectClipRgn of an empty region as EMR_EXTSELECTCLIPRGN
(RGN_COPY) with a region of 0 rectangles. ExtSelectClipRgn stored an empty
list, and SelectClip wrote 'q n h W n': a clip operator without a path,
which a viewer may take as no clip, so a bitmap drawn after it could stay
visible. Such a region is now one empty box, as IntersectClip stores when
nothing is left: 'q n 0 0 0 0 re h W n'.

Test TTestUiPdf.EmfEmptyClip: the bitmap after an empty region, and after
two disjoint IntersectClipRect, lies under a clip of zero area that holds;
the empty region fails on master. Delphi 7, Delphi 13 Win32/Win64, FPC
3.3.1 and FPC 3.2.2 Win64 pass all; FPC 3.2.2 Win32 fails
MetafileRenderingAndOrientation #3 with or without this change.
commits.author: Sven Harazim
